races.notes: Tuberville is retiring to run for governor.

Ranked-choice general election with four candidates from the top-four primary. The incumbent appears on the ballot as 'Dan S. Sullivan'. Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. of Petersburg is a different person; he filed as a Republican, re-registered as undeclared, and appears on the ballot with no party label. Gerald Heikes (fifth in the primary) replaced Democrat David Leslie, who withdrew.
Special election for the final two years of Marco Rubio's term (expires January 2029). Moody was appointed January 21, 2025. Florida has no regular Senate seat on the 2026 ballot.
No Democratic nominee on the ballot: Democrat David Roth withdrew. Independent Todd Achilles is the principal challenger.
Cassidy was defeated in the Republican primary; he remains the seat holder through the end of the term.
Ranked-choice general election. Ballotpedia lists the Democratic nominee as Troy Dale Jackson.
No Democratic nominee on the ballot: Democrat Cindy Burbank withdrew. Independent Dan Osborn is the principal challenger.
Special election for the final two years of JD Vance's term. Husted was appointed January 17, 2025. Ohio has no regular Senate seat on the 2026 ballot.
Regular Class 2 election. Armstrong was appointed March 24, 2026, after Markwayne Mullin resigned, and is not running for the full term.
270toWin lists the Republican nominee as David Smith; Ballotpedia lists him as David Brock Smith.

Lindsey Graham, who had won renomination in the June 9 primary, died July 11, 2026. Gov. Henry McMaster appointed his sister, Darline Graham (also reported as Darline Graham Nordone; Nordone is her married name), on July 13, 2026. She won the August 25 special Republican primary runoff over Ralph Norman and appears on the ballot and the official Senate roster under her legal name, Darline Graham.
No Democratic nominee on the ballot: Democrat Julian Beaudion withdrew. Independent Brian Bengs is the principal challenger.
Cornyn was defeated in the Republican primary; he remains the seat holder through the end of the term.
